title: SMB simplified listing microplaybook + risk matrix
body:
Purpose:
This microplaybook is a compact, practical checklist and copy bank for launching SMB-focused listings on cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). Aim: reduce friction for early marketplace pilots by offering a narrow, low-friction SKU + trial flow with clear rollback criteria and a simple risk matrix tailored for small customers and ISVs.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: GTM product owners, partner ops, partner engineering, legal intake for listings, and marketplace ops.
- Scope: SMB trial SKU design, condensed acceptance gates, short + long tile copy variants, telemetry/telemetry minimums, entitlement mapping, billing basics, and a concise risk matrix plus incident runbook triggers. Not a replacement for full enterprise listing playbooks.

TL;DR (for partner-facing leads):
- Offer a single "Starter" SKU with 14-day trial (no credit card), 30k token cap during trial, auto-opt-in to pay-as-you-go after trial unless customer cancels.
- Require SSO only for enterprise AND provide quick-account provisioning for SMB via email link.
- Minimum telemetry: activation event, first API call, error rate, and billing metering events.
- Launch checklist below — if any of the 4 critical gates fail, delay launch and escalate to partner-ops.

Critical acceptance gates (must-pass):
1) Billing integration: test billing metering + trial entitlement issuance end-to-end in marketplace sandbox (trial entitlement ID issued, callback verified).
2) Security baseline: app uses customer-managed KMS for customer data if requested; marketplace listing passes security intake (basic pen-test / vuln scan if required).
3) Trial UX: trial activation link in listing lands on a one-click enable flow that returns a 200 within 3s for first page load.
4) Telemetry & monitoring: activation, first API token issuance, 1st request, error spike alerting configured.

Secondary acceptance gates (recommended):
- SSO optional for SMB, but supported for enterprise flows.
- Docs and quickstart in tile with links to 3-step sample app + Postman cURL.
- Support SLA documented: community chat + email; for Dedicated/Private lead to enterprise terms.

Sample tile copy (short title + 1-line use case) — keep < 60 chars for tile title and < 140 chars for short description. Provide three tones: direct, product-led, and marketplace-native.
- Variant A (direct): Redwood Inference — Fast, cost-conscious LLM inference for product teams. Try 14 days free, no card.
- Variant B (product-led): Run real LLM traffic with low-cost inference. Start a 14-day trial — sample app included.
- Variant C (marketplace-native): Scalable LLM inference — trial and pay-as-you-go billing via the marketplace.

Longer description (tile body copy) — 2 short paragraphs, customer-facing:
- Paragraph 1: Explain value (latency, cost controls, and simple scaling): "Redwood Inference provides a developer-first inference runtime optimized for predictable latency and lower per-token costs. Ship features faster with built-in batching, KV caching, and model variants that keep your app online when demand spikes."
- Paragraph 2: Explain trial and what to expect: "Enable a 14-day free trial with a 30k token cap and sample templates for chat, summarization, and embeddings. No credit card required — upgrade to pay-as-you-go at any time through the marketplace console."

Help text / FAQ snippets to include on tile detail page:
- "What’s included in the trial?" — 14 days, 30k token cap, sample app and SDK keys.
- "Do I need to sign an MSA?" — No for SMB trial; enterprise deals may require MSA.
- "How is billing handled?" — Marketplace handles metering/billing for PAYG; reserved capacity handled outside marketplace.

Entitlement and SKU mapping (plain lines):
- SKU name: Redwood-Starter (marketplace)
- Trial entitlement id: rwd_trial_14d_smb (mapped in partner-provisioning)
- Included units: 30k tokens free trial, after which PAYG via marketplace SKU metering applies
- Upgrade path: Marketplace PAYG => Sales outreach for Reserved/Dedicated for > $X/mo threshold

Minimum telemetry & observability (events to emit during trial):
- trial_activated (timestamp, partner_id, marketplace_account_id)
- api_key_issued (timestamp, sdk_variant)
- first_request (latency_ms, model, seq_len)
- meter_event (tokens_consumed, sku_id)
- error_rate_heartbeat (5m window)
Implementation notes: emit as HTTP webhook to partner-ops endpoint + snapshot to internal console.

SMB-focused UX constraints (keep it lean):
- No mandatory SSO for trial; optional SSO link for enterprise customers.
- No mandatory KYC for trial.
- Minimum friction: < 3 clicks from tile to first request in sample app.

Risk matrix (SMB listing specific) — rows: Risk, Likelihood, Impact, Mitigation, Owner
- Billing mis-metering, Medium, High, Test in marketplace sandbox + reconcile script (daily), Partner-ops
- Trial abuse (bots), Medium, Medium, Rate-limits + CAP of 30k + basic email verification, Product/Infra
- Unexpected high-latency, Low, High, Canary model variant + auto-fallback to lower-cost variant, Serving-runtime
- Data residency mismatch, Low, High (for some EU customers), Offer Private deployment path + clear tile note, Sales/Legal
- Support overload (sudden spike from listing), Medium, Medium, Temporary banner in console + auto-throttle new signups and paged support, Customer Success

Quick rollback / triage triggers (if any of these are observed, immediately pause listing tile and escalate):
- Marketplace billing callback failures > 1 hour (reason: subscription sync failure)
- Error rate > 10% sustained for 10 minutes across new trial accounts
- Metering double-counting detected in reconciliation
- Unauthorized access pattern consistent with credential stuffing
Actions after pause:
1) Post an incident note in #marketplace-launch and call partner-ops on-call.
2) Flip marketplace tile to "paused" state and disable trial entitlement issuance.
3) Run reconciliation script and unblock billing or revert to snapshot from N-1 hour.
4) Send templated status update to affected customers (see templates below).

Templated status update (short) — for customers: 
"Hi — we detected an issue affecting trial activations and have temporarily paused new trials while we fix it. Existing active trials are unaffected. We expect a resolution within X hours. — Redwood Inference"

Operational playbook checklist before launch (pre-flight):
- [ ] Marketplace sandbox test: entitlement issuance, billing callback, upgrade flow
- [ ] E2E sample app test: provisioning to first API call in < 3 clicks
- [ ] Telemetry webhooks configured and integrated with console dashboards
- [ ] Reconciliation script scheduled and tested (daily)
- [ ] Support templates ready + on-call rotation confirmed
- [ ] Legal confirms trial terms + ARR conversion defn for switching to Sales motion
- [ ] Tile copy variants approved by marketing

Open questions / TODOs (owner):
- Does finance want trial-to-pay conversion threshold (e.g. $200/mo) to auto-trigger sales outreach? (Finance — @Lina)
- Confirm marketplace SKU limits per region (Partner-eng — @Devon)
- Do we need a simplified privacy blurb for EU tile variants? (Legal — @Omar)

Contacts & ownership:
- Playbook owner: Ava Chen (GTM)
- Partner-ops: Omar Patel
- Marketplace eng + billing: Devon Park
- Legal intake: Lina Morales

Next steps (next 2 weeks):
1) Run full sandbox E2E and capture fail/pass with timestamps (Devon)
2) Choose tile copy variant and create assets for each cloud marketplace (Marketing)
3) Draft support escalation templates and schedule on-call for first 72 hours after launch (Customer Success)
4) Finalize reconciliation automation and run one dry-run (Infra)

Notes to self / rough experiments:
- Experiment: 7-day vs 14-day trial split test for SMB signup to measure activation -> paid conversion rate.
- Keep copy concise; SMB buyers respond to 'no card' and 'start in 3 minutes' language.
- Consider a single-step Postman collection as the canonical "first request" sample for faster onboarding.

References:
- Ticket: JIRA-GTM-987 "SMB marketplace pilot"
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-12345 "Marketplace SMB playbook"
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-assets/pull/42

End of doc.
